svg.title: Azure DevOps remediation pattern for agentic Doc as Code
svg.desc: Azure Repos triggers Azure Pipelines. Deterministic DAC produces architecture evidence. An optional Microsoft Foundry Agent produces bounded structured output. An independent verifier checks the patch. Azure Repos policies govern the draft pull request and merge.
svg.text: Azure DevOps remediation pattern for agentic Doc as Code
Recommended custom architecture · source-defined pattern · not implemented in the workshop MVP
Azure Repos has native AI review and local agent assistance, but not full GitHub cloud-agent / Agentic Workflows parity.
Mitigation: keep generated facts deterministic, add a governed Foundry invocation, and publish through Azure Repos-specific PR APIs.
Agent optional: evidence may bypass Foundry
Static configuration and recommended controls—not proof of a deployed integration.
